text: We moved to the farm when I was 10, and that's when I got my first job baling hay, fixing fences, and taking care of livestock. I know that things are tough right now for working families. So, in Congress, I sponsored the law that eliminates taxes on tips and overtime. I've cut taxes for seniors on Social Security. And just like the jobs on the farm, we've done a lot, but together there's a lot more we can do. And I approve this message.

I started here sweeping floors to help my mom make ends meet. Now Washington's making messes faster than we can clean them up: ignoring our border, jacking up prices, lining their own pockets as we fall behind. Joe Biden and Kamala Harris have let us down. I'll clean things up. I'll secure our border, tackle inflation and ban Congress from trading stocks. I approve this message because it's time to clean up Congress.

I grew up right here in Ohio. My wife and I raised our family here. I served 25 years as a prosecutor fighting for safe communities. Now I go to work every day delivering common-sense results for Ohio: cutting taxes, delivering resources for our communities, promoting skilled trades and fighting to make life more affordable and prosperous for Ohio families. I'm asking for your vote this November to continue working for you. And I approve this message.

My grandfather served in World War II. He taught me the importance of service before self. I graduated from the Air Force Academy, led special operations forces, and became a CIA case officer. I served under Republican and Democratic presidents. I can bring both parties together and find common ground: stopping corruption, lowering your costs, and making your health care more affordable. It starts with service before self. And I approve this message because you deserve better.

For most families a home is more than just a roof over their head. It's independence, security, where memories are made. But Wall Street investors are now buying one in six homes across Ohio, jacking up prices, boxing out home buyers, causing rents to skyrocket. Ohio families shouldn't be priced out by Wall Street greed. That's why I'm cracking down on predatory investors to boost affordable housing. These streets belong to Ohio. That's why I approve this message.

Ohio's electric grid. Big corporations treat it like a game, gobbling up energy to feed their data centers, no matter how much it raises our prices. It's the latest way they've rigged the system, costing the average Ohioan thousands of dollars, with prices still going up. I'll require the data centers pay the full cost of their electricity, not you. They don't get to play games with your energy bill. That's why I approve this message.

Please remain on the line, as we value your call. My doctor says I need the treatment, but the insurance company says I need permission. Zero medical training and they overrule my doctor? It's true, and they make money every day you wait. I'll ban insurance companies from blocking care your doctor approved and fine them when they wrongly deny claims. Ohio's been on hold long enough. Health decisions should be between you and your doctor. That's why I approved this message.

Every day, twelve Ohioans die of a drug overdose, and some of the most dangerous drugs are the ones brought here illegally. I sponsored the law, signed by President Trump, to crack down on illegal drugs being smuggled across the border, and now I'm working to punish the Chinese companies and Mexican cartels profiting off the fentanyl. I've always stood up for us, and I'm fighting to keep our communities safe. And I approve this message.

Together with President Trump, I'm delivering results for hardworking Ohio families. I led the fight to fully fund border security, stopping Joe Biden's unchecked flow of illegal immigration and deadly drugs into Ohio. I have President Trump's complete and total endorsement because I deliver for America first and for Ohio. In the May 5th Republican primary, stand with President Trump and vote to reelect me. And I approve this message.

Khadija Abdullahi was thrown to the ground by ICE agents. We have watched as ICE has operated with impunity in Chicago. They destroy homes, kill our neighbors, and disappear hundreds. ICE has arrested press. We've heard of grandmothers and pregnant women sleeping on concrete floors. Trump, ICE and Kristi Noem won't even follow the Geneva Conventions. We are at a turning point. So, are we going to stand up for the people, or are we going to let ICE do as it pleases?
